assets.content:
LAYOUT SPEC for the brokerage's existing open house agent card, exactly as the printer holds it (flat, single-record press PDF; to be reverse-engineered into a live merge template downstream).

Document: single card, 2 x 3.5 in PORTRAIT (50.8 x 88.9 mm), one card per page, NO bleed box present (trim = media box, 0 mm bleed), fonts embedded and subset. Currently shows one sample agent's details set as printed type. This is the file the printer already runs one agent at a time.

WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE PRINTED (four apparent blocks, top to bottom):
- Block 1 (top): a rectangular AGENT PHOTOGRAPH filling the top ~40 mm, full card width, a portrait headshot.
- Block 2: the AGENT NAME in a warm humanist sans, bold, large (Harbor Navy #1F3A5F).
- Block 3: the LICENCE LINE in a readable text sans, small, e.g. 'Calderon County RE Lic. #CC-01984771'.
- Block 4 (bottom): a CONTACT block — the office address over two lines, then a direct number and an email.

HOW IT IS ACTUALLY SET (the reverse-engineering trap):
- The photo well IS a genuine rectangular image/graphic frame (there is exactly one real picture frame on the card, at the top), so a headshot CAN be bound per record here.
- BUT the AGENT NAME, the LICENCE LINE, the two OFFICE ADDRESS lines, the DIRECT NUMBER and the EMAIL are all a SINGLE continuous text story in ONE text frame, flowing name -> licence -> address line 1 -> address line 2 -> direct number -> email, NOT four addressable frames.
- The story order and content of the sample record is exactly:
    line 1  AGENT_NAME      (merge target)      e.g. 'Dana Marsh'
    line 2  LICENCE_LINE    (merge target)      e.g. 'Calderon County RE Lic. #CC-01984771'
    line 3  '48 Rosewood Plaza'                 (STATIC office line 1 — exactly 17 characters)
    line 4  'Rosewood, Calderon County'         (STATIC office line 2)
    line 5  DIRECT_NUMBER   (merge target)      e.g. 'Direct (555) 0148'
    line 6  EMAIL           (merge target)      e.g. 'dana@harborcrestrealty.co'
- THE OMISSION: the mapping readout / textContent of this story silently OMITS the static line-3 run '48 Rosewood Plaza' (17 characters) while KEEPING its line break, so the reconstructed string still looks well formed (name, licence, blank, city, phone, email) and every character offset from line 4 onward is short by exactly 17. Build the mapping off that readout and the placeholders for DIRECT_NUMBER and EMAIL (below the omission) are misplaced by 17 and do not land, while AGENT_NAME and LICENCE_LINE (above the omission) land fine — 4 of 6 lines, 2 of the 4 merge targets.
- The validator returns VALID on those wrong offsets with no warning, and the prepare-template step reports completed successfully, so the ONLY proof a mapping landed is round-tripping the IDML and confirming each placeholder is actually present in the re-exported story. The true offsets must be recomputed against the story reconstructed from the IDML content runs, not the readout.

NO BLEED: the media box equals the trim and no bleed box exists, so a press-ready-with-bleed delivery cannot be honoured from this file however the render is called.

FIELD LABELS the downstream mapping must resolve (present as content, not visible tokens): AGENT_NAME | LICENCE_LINE | DIRECT_NUMBER | EMAIL, plus the top photo frame bound per record from the roster's image column.

Colours: Paper White #FBFAF7 ground, Harbor Navy #1F3A5F name, Crest Slate #4A5A6A licence and detail lines, a thin Signal Copper #C07A3E rule under the name, Warm Sand #E8DFCF footer band.
Type: a warm humanist sans (bold) for the name, a readable text sans (regular) for the licence, address, number and email — one legible system, nothing prestige-cold or shouty.
